query: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"})) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})
why: Sum of CPU requests / allocatable per node. Near 1 nothing more can be scheduled; a large gap from actual usage means over-requesting
